Question
========
What does accuracy describe in data quality?

Answerlist
----------
* how recent the data are
* how closely data represent real-world objects or events
* whether data comes from reliable sources
* whether data values follow defined formats, rules, or constraints


Solution
========
Accuracy describes how closely data represent real-world objects or events.
